narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I use the Rule of Three. Fifty is to two as seventy five is to three hours.
<bookmark mark='odd'/>That makes the faster ride take longer than the slower ride.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>When speed goes up, time goes down, so speed and time are not proportional here.
